hook: Your camera on Venus would last about two hours.
title: A camera survived two hours on Venus
description:
In 1982 the Soviet Venera 13 lander touched down on Venus and sent back the first colour photos of its surface. It survived about two hours in heat hot enough to melt lead. Engineers had only planned for around half an hour.

Series: If You Were in Space.
comment_prompt: Would you visit Venus? Yes or no
